palette.day: existing warm paper and jade tokens

layers.name: far
layers.motion: existing GSAP entry and parallax; stopped while hidden

layers.name: subject
layers.source: album art, page heading or lyric typography
layers.motion: subject at 0ms, identity at 80ms, navigation at 110–160ms

layers.name: content
layers.source: track rows, playlist grids, queue and comments
layers.motion: viewport intersection; nonlinear bounded stagger; shared Motion adapter

layers.name: lyric-subject
layers.motion: seeded segmentation and alternating character placement, current-line-only React updates

layers.name: overlay
layers.motion: lyrics pause visual subscription when hidden and yield to dialogs or quality menu

states.enter: artwork/heading, then secondary navigation, then visible content
states.scroll: animate only newly visible unseen items; overscan stays pending
states.virtual-remount: stable identity prevents replay and bounds the history cache
states.pause: audio state unchanged; stop continuous lyric clock
states.hidden: cancel visual observers, Motion animations, lyric RAF and subscriptions
states.reduce-motion: render complete content immediately and use readable scroll lyrics
states.dialog: fixed dialog title and pagination, independent comment scrolling; temporarily hide desktop lyrics
states.close-window: remove main view; retain audio and optional desktop lyric surface
states.lock: retain playback/pause; hide desktop lyrics; use compact lock media card

safeAreas.desktop: quality menu constrained to native window; desktop lyrics default above mini player
safeAreas.narrow: responsive drawer, larger fixed-height rows, accessible compact quality trigger
